item.title: ChatTree 0.1.0
item.description:
First build for early testers.

  • Map of each conversation: every prompt becomes a node attached to the idea it builds on, grouped into topics, as a thought map or a tree.
  • Claude Code built in: a terminal panel runs your own Claude Code (you sign in yourself). Sessions started from ChatTree are mapped as you go, and the map follows the terminal.
  • Continue from here: pick any node and ChatTree writes the message that takes Claude back there, ready in the terminal (never sent until you press Enter), or in a new branch session.
  • Maps for older sessions: "Build a map on this Mac" (private, using Apple's on-device model), and "Organize with Claude" with your own API key to sort a map into topics.
  • Regular Claude chats: shown view-only; import past chats from Claude's data export (File → Import Claude Chats…).

Known limits: Apple silicon Macs only; this build isn't signed with an Apple Developer ID yet (see "How to open ChatTree").
